It'll be tough to start any Dolphin next week against the Bills.

news.analysis: Judkins totaled over 70 yards of offense on his 13 touches in Sunday's comeback win over the Texans. The second-year back put the Browns ahead with a five-yard TD plunge with less than a minute left to go in the game. Judkins is up to 423 yards and four touchdowns on the ground through nine games. He's also caught at least three passes four times this season.

news.analysis: Miami placed Willis on injured reserve last week after an MRI showed his lingering groin issue had become a core muscle injury. He'll miss at least three more games. The team expected him back before the season ended, but potential surgery puts that return in doubt. He is only worth holding in deep superflex and 2QB leagues until there's an update. Kyle McCord remains Miami's starter.
news.contents: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that no decision has been made on whether QB Malik Willis (groin/core) needs surgery.
news.title: Malik Willis' surgery decision still pending

news.contents: Miami Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said that as of Monday, a decision has not been made about whether quarterback Malik Willis (groin, core) will require surgery, according to Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN. The Dolphins are hopeful that Willis can play again this year, but if the 27-year-old needs to go under the knife, he will most likely not return in 2026.
